machine.name: The Walking Dead Premium / Limited Edition

mechanisms.behavior: Four balls begin at switches 18-21. A drained ball enters the left end; the working script settles vacancies from 18 toward 21 after 150 ms, and output 1 ejects the ball at switch 21 toward the shooter lane. Switch 22 is the entrance/jam opto.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: Output 2 fires the automatic plunger for a ball resting at shooter-lane switch 23.
mechanisms.label: Auto launcher

mechanisms.behavior: The doors use a dual-winding power/hold coil. The known-working script starts opening on output 3 and starts closing when output 4 de-asserts. Despite the manual name 'Prison Doors Closed', the script reports switch 4 inactive at the closed initial position and active at its fully open position; switch 46 reports ball passage through the door opto.
mechanisms.label: Dual prison doors

positions.description: Initial runtime state; switch 4 is inactive in the known-working script.
positions.label: Closed

positions.description: Known-working script sets switch 4 active at the open stop.
positions.label: Open

mechanisms.behavior: Output 5 energizes the magnetic diverter zone. The working script applies magnetic force directly to balls entering that zone; there is no separate position switch.
mechanisms.label: Ramp diverter magnet

mechanisms.behavior: The Well Walker is a spring-return target with a magnetic ball-control zone. Switch 2 is active at rest in the working script, clears on a hit, and reactivates when the toy returns. Output 6 controls the well magnet.
mechanisms.label: Well Walker target and magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Output 7 controls the prison capture magnet. The working script adds a ball when it enters the prison magnet zone and releases it with a small randomized lateral/forward velocity when the magnet turns off.
mechanisms.label: Prison capture magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Targets 9-11 latch down and keep their switches active. Output 12 raises all three targets; the script uses approximately 110 ms down travel, 40 ms initial up travel, and 40 ms at the raised overshoot before settling.
mechanisms.label: Left three-bank drop targets

mechanisms.behavior: Switches 30-32 pulse the corresponding pop-bumper mechanisms driven by outputs 9-11.
mechanisms.label: Three pop bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: Switches 26 and 27 pulse the left and right slingshot assemblies driven by outputs 13 and 14.
mechanisms.label: Left and right slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: SAM fast-flip inputs drive outputs 15 and 16. The normally-closed EOS contacts are exposed at PinMAME switches 83 (left) and 81 (right).
mechanisms.label: Lower flippers

mechanisms.behavior: At home, switch 50 is active and switch 52 is active only while a ball is loaded. Output 21 starts the sweep: the script clears 50 and 52, activates mark switch 51 near the center, reverses at the far limit, then restores 50 and any loaded-ball state on return. Output 51 ejects the carried ball in the current cannon direction.
mechanisms.label: Motorized crossbow cannon

mechanisms.behavior: Output 52 forces target 48 down; output 53 raises it. Switch 48 remains active while the target is down.
mechanisms.label: Right single drop target

mechanisms.behavior: The physical ramp uses dual-winding outputs 55 (short power/open pulse) and 56 (hold). The known-working script intentionally keys animation from output 56: asserted raises the ramp and removes the blocking surface; de-asserted lowers it and restores the surface. It does not attach a callback to the short output-55 pulse.
mechanisms.label: Bicycle Girl motorized ramp

mechanisms.behavior: A ball hit pulses switch 49 and deflects the spring-return Bicycle Girl figure before it returns to rest.
mechanisms.label: Bicycle Girl bash target

mechanisms.behavior: A ball hit pulses switch 3 and deflects the spring-return Prison Walker figure before it returns to rest.
mechanisms.label: Prison Walker bash target

mechanisms.behavior: Each spinner rotation pulses its switch: right spinner 1 and left-loop spinner 40.
mechanisms.label: Left and right spinners
